[[File:NRSSDeeve.png|thumb|right|Deeve on the planet]]
A '''planet''' had a hostile [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that could [[Death/Legends|kill]] an [[Arpor-Lan]] without a protective suit and a [[Breath mask/Legends|face breather]]. It had high [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] with cliffs that towered over swirling, lethally hot, while beautiful, mists. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was unfamiliar with the local fauna, but at least one [[Unidentified tentacled being|four-meter, four-tentacled creature without a identifiable head]] lived there.

The [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]] sent the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[NRSS Founder|NRSS ''Founder'']] from [[Outer Region Foxar Scout Base]], to survey this [[Planet/Legends|planet]], along with several others in eight [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], in search of valuable natural resources, including veins of minerals. The [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Deeve]], with suitable protection, climbed up one of the peaks to perform an analysis with his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[REM-02]] while his crewmates, [[Effcee]] and [[Jarsa]], did other tasks on the ship. While doing so, Deeve was found by the previously-mentioned tentacled creature and, instinctively, shot it with his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].
